responsibility: Provides the master table of runtime entry points used by the Go frontend, listing each generated-code helper’s symbolic name together with compact parameter and result type codes. This definition file is included by runtime support code to generate the `Runtime::Function` enum and the runtime-signature table, making it the authoritative catalog of libgo and builtin helper calls referenced during lowering.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the X-macro master list of runtime entry points and compact parameter/result type codes that `runtime.h` and `runtime.cc` include to generate enums and signature tables. Unlike `runtime.cc`, it has no runtime-call construction logic, and unlike `runtime.h`, it is data for code generation rather than a frontend API declaration.
